name: Rock Park Play Area
description: Riverside park on the Taw in Barnstaple, mostly looked after by Barnstaple Town Council, with a children's play area, public toilets and a refreshment kiosk. North Devon Council runs the skatepark. The play equipment was commended for its condition in the 2024 South West in Bloom Pride in Parks awards.
